source.source_title: Amendment of the General Code of Conduct for Authorised FSPs and Representatives, 2020

locator.quote: A provider must establish and maintain an adequate complaints management framework.

source_gate.gate_reason: The source pack permits amendment-specific candidate obligations when the staged commencement table and human review are preserved.

classification.classification_rationale: The amendment is an in-force Gazette notice. The staged commencement control was retained and reviewed before approval of this synthetic obligation record.

trigger_conditions: the institution renders regulated financial services as an authorised provider

timing.value: while the regulated activity is performed

exceptions_and_dependencies: the assessment remains limited to the synthetic institution profile and supplied amendment source
evidence_or_reporting_requirements: operating records showing that the framework is maintained
obligation.atomic_summary: An authorised provider must establish and maintain an adequate complaints management framework.
interpretation_notes: Approval confirms the synthetic obligation record and applicability assumption, not control effectiveness or institutional compliance.
The evidence items are assurance needs and do not extend the source obligation.

assumptions: The fictional institution is treated as an authorised provider for this controlled evaluation.
applicability.rationale: A qualified synthetic reviewer accepted applicability for the evaluation profile, subject to the stated fictional licensing assumption.

change.change_summary: Government Notice 706 of 2020 inserted a structured complaints-management framework into the General Code amendment chain.

operating_impact.rationale: The approved obligation concerns the design and maintenance of the complaints framework and related customer-outcomes oversight. Control mapping remains separately reviewable.

limitations: This is a synthetic applicability approval, not legal advice.
The complete current General Code amendment chain is not represented as a consolidated source.
